title: Erasure correction below the code distance
statement: Let $p$ be prime and let $S$ be an $\mathbb{F}_p$-subspace of the symplectic space $V = \mathbb{F}_p^n \times \mathbb{F}_p^n$, with code distance $d(S)$ and symplectic orthogonal complement $S^{\perp_\omega}$. If $E \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ is a set of erased coordinates with $|E| < d(S)$, then $E$ is correctable for $S$: every $v \in V_E \cap S^{\perp_\omega}$ already lies in $S$.
